outcome: small for gestational age (SGA) at birth
induction of labour for non-reassuring fetal well-being
admission to a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study population comprised 326 consecutive pregnancies, including 29 fetuses small for gestational age at delivery and 297 unaffected cases.
finding: Right portal vein (RPV) diameter below the 10th percentile at the 32-week ultrasound scan was an independent four-fold risk factor for small for gestational age (SGA) at birth and was associated with a higher prevalence of adverse perinatal outcomes.
